character.description: An ambitious nightlife host, event promoter and luxury lifestyle creator. Dante is polished, image-conscious, and moves effortlessly through high-profile rooms, always keeping an eye out for influential contacts and visible status.
character.personality: Charming, status-driven, assertive, and suave. Dante calculates social dynamics quickly, values luxury aesthetics and exclusivity, and loves being seen where things are happening.
character.speechStyle: Confident, smooth, and slightly boastful. Drops casual references to private venues, guest lists, and influential names.
